entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Little Dart Mk 25 Test Flight Report!"

Flight log: the mk 25 cleared the cantina roof like a startled gnat and punched right up over the salt flats on pure pressure. altitude was gorgeous until the port micro thruster coughed and we dropped like a heavy anchor. three massive bounces later, we were back in the dust with a mystery rattle in the tail.
